import workcell

def st():
    r = workcell.robot("status")
    print("STATUS", r.text, r.data)

# compute expected fixture corners
import math
cx, cy, yaw = 441.346, 250.633, math.radians(3.8325)
# 140 x 90, x along yaw (length), y along yaw+90 (width)
# From bore layout, length 140 along yaw, width 90 along yaw+90
def corner(lx, ly):
    # lx along length axis, ly along width axis, from center
    x = cx + lx*math.cos(yaw) - ly*math.sin(yaw)
    y = cy + lx*math.sin(yaw) + ly*math.cos(yaw)
    return x, y

for name, lx, ly in [("SW", -70, -45), ("SE", 70, -45), ("NW", -70, 45), ("NE", 70, 45)]:
    print(name, corner(lx, ly))

# approach from -Y (south) outside fixture toward center at z=15
# south edge midpoint
sx, sy = corner(0, -45)
print("south edge", sx, sy)
# start outside
ox, oy = corner(0, -45-30)
print("outside", ox, oy)
r = workcell.robot("move", ox, oy, 80)
print("approach high", r.text, r.data)
r = workcell.robot("move", ox, oy, 15)
print("approach low", r.text, r.data)
st()
# move toward fixture, should contact side
r = workcell.robot("move", sx+5*math.sin(yaw), sy-5*math.cos(yaw), 15)  # 5mm inside

st()
